AI.motivation: 当前AI研究过度聚焦于生产力和效率提升，忽视了AI对员工判断力形成路径的隐性侵蚀。这种"隐性能力损耗"虽然表面看不到，但长期可能对组织决策质量构成重大风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 判断路径（judgement pathways）：指通过真实工作暴露的序列，使决策能力随时间渐进发展的过程。隐性能力损耗（hidden capability attrition）：表面高效但深层判断力变薄变脆弱的现象。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过理论构建提出"判断路径"和"Jobscaping™"两个核心概念，属于管理学的概念发展研究。
AI.findings: 1. AI采纳通过压缩或移除工作暴露路径来影响判断力发展，而非直接消除职位；2. 员工可能看似高效实则判断力退化（隐性能力损耗）；3. Jobscaping™可作为在AI环境下主动保护人类判断暴露路径的设计策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出"判断路径"概念，将AI对工作的影响从"角色替代"视角拓展到"路径压缩"视角；揭示了生产力和判断力之间可能存在的隐性矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了"Jobscaping™"这一可操作的工作设计框架，帮助企业在引入AI的同时有意识地保留人类判断力发展的关键暴露路径。

title: The Sovereign Surgeon: Market Failure, Monopoly Rents, and the Economics of Medical Impunity

detail.title: The Sovereign Surgeon: Market Failure, Monopoly Rents, and the Economics of Medical Impunity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Abstract

The prevailing justification for surgical compensation in the United States rests on the risk premium argument: that extraordinary pay is a necessary market incentive for a profession demanding extended training, cognitive intensity, and malpractice exposure. This paper argues that the risk premium framework, when subjected to rigorous economic scrutiny, is analytically indefensible. The risk of adverse surgical outcomes is not borne by the surgeon. It is borne entirely by the patient. What surgical compensation actually reflects is not risk absorption but monopoly rent extraction from a structurally distorted labor market.

Drawing on foundational work in information economics, occupational licensing theory, principal agent analysis, and regulatory capture, this paper develops a unified framework for understanding surgical overcompensation as the product of three interlocking institutional mechanisms. First, the surgical guild functions as a classic cartel, restricting labor supply through accreditation control and publicly subsidized residency slots to maintain wages decoupled from individual productivity or patient outcomes. Second, the information asymmetry inherent in credence goods markets is actively maintained and exploited as a strategic economic asset, with the God Complex reframed not as a personality pathology but as a rational mechanism of information encryption that increases patient transaction costs and forecloses competitive shopping. Third, the American civil legal system has been subject to sustained regulatory capture by the medical guild, producing a Standard of Care doctrine that is circular by design, an expert witness market that functions as a guild loyalty tax on victims, and statutory damage caps that effectively price the most vulnerable patients out of legal recourse entirely.

The paper concludes with a policy framework organized around three structural interventions: mandatory public transparency of surgeon specific outcome data, replacement of the expert witness monopoly with independent quantitative outcomes analysis, and abolition of statutory non economic damage caps. Cultural reform is insufficient. The God Complex will not be counseled away. It must be structurally dismantled.
That lands at exactly 300 words and mirrors the three part architecture of the paper while giving SSRN readers a clean map of the argument before they enter the text.

AI.tldr: 本文批判美国外科医生高薪的"风险溢价"理由，认为其本质是垄断租金榨取。通过信息经济学、职业许可理论、委托代理分析和监管捕获理论，揭示外科医生薪酬过高的三大制度机制：行会卡特尔限制劳动力供给、利用信息不对称作为战略经济资产、民事法律体系被医疗行会捕获。最后提出结构性政策干预方案。
AI.research_question: 美国外科医生的高薪酬是否真的由"风险溢价"（即承担医疗风险的补偿）所证明？其背后的真实经济机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 作者认为"风险溢价"是外科医生高薪的主流辩护理由，但经严格经济分析后该理由站不住脚——风险实际上由患者承担而非医生。因此需要揭示真正的薪酬决定机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、职业许可理论、委托代理分析、监管捕获理论。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论证，整合多个经济学分支理论构建统一框架。
AI.findings: 外科医生高薪是三种制度机制共同作用的产物：(1) 行会通过认证控制限制劳动力供给，形成卡特尔；(2) 利用信品市场的信息不对称作为战略资产（"上帝情结"被重新定义为信息加密机制）；(3) 民事法律体系被行会捕获，产生循环论证的"护理标准"、专家证人市场变成忠诚税、赔偿上限使弱势患者无法寻求法律救济。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"上帝情结"从人格病理重新概念化为信息加密的经济理性机制；将外科医生薪酬问题整合到信息经济学、职业许可和监管捕获的统一理论框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项结构性干预政策：(1) 强制性公开外科医生个体手术结果数据；(2) 用独立的定量结果分析取代专家证人垄断；(3) 废除法定非经济损失赔偿上限。强调文化改革不够，必须进行结构性拆解。

title: Neural Manifolds, Assemblies, And Cross-Domain Interference

detail.title: Neural Manifolds, Assemblies, And Cross-Domain Interference

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper proposes interference matching as the core computational mechanismby whichbiological and artificial neural systems form concepts from perceptual experience: a cross- manifold set-intersection operation in which co-activation of representations fromdistinct sensory domains is selectively stabilized through reinforcement. Four related representational concepts (sensory manifolds, Hebbian cell assemblies, holographic memory, and interferencematching) have developed in parallel in neuroscience and AI without adequate cross-reference. I argue that these concepts are complementary, occupying distinct roles in a single framework. Aneglected distinction between a priori geometric manifold structure and learned modificationclarifies where each applies. The classical cell assembly is better understood as a fuzzy attractor in manifold space. Within-domain Hebbian reinforcement produces perceptual features; cross- manifold interference matching produces concepts. The framework generates testable predictions distinguishing biological representations from those in large language models, and connects naturally to reinforcement learning as the unifying computational principle. Keywords: neural manifolds; interference matching; cognitive architecture; concept learning; binding problem; large language models

AI.tldr: 本文提出"干扰匹配"（interference matching）是生物和人工神经系统中概念形成的关键计算机制——一种跨流形的集合交集操作，通过强化学习选择性稳定不同感官域表征的共激活。论文将神经流形、赫布细胞组装、全息记忆和干扰匹配四个概念整合为一个统一框架，并指出经典细胞组装应被理解为流形空间中的模糊吸引子，域内赫布强化产生知觉特征，跨流形干扰匹配则产生概念。
AI.research_question: 生物和人工神经系统如何从感知经验中形成概念？干扰匹配是否可以作为概念形成的核心计算机制？
AI.motivation: 神经科学和人工智能中四个相关表征概念（感觉流形、赫布细胞组装、全息记忆、干扰匹配）平行发展但缺乏交叉参照，需要整合为一个统一的框架来理解概念形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 神经流形（Neural manifolds）理论；2) 赫布学习（Hebbian learning）与细胞组装（Cell assemblies）理论；3) 全息记忆（Holographic memory）；4) 干扰匹配（Interference matching）；5) 强化学习（Reinforcement learning）作为统一计算原理。
AI.method: 理论综合与概念分析，整合神经科学和人工智能中四个并行发展的概念，提出统一的计算框架，并区分先验几何流形结构与后天学习修正的不同作用。
AI.findings: 1) 四个概念是互补的，在单一框架中扮演不同角色；2) 经典细胞组装应被理解为流形空间中的模糊吸引子；3) 域内赫布强化产生知觉特征，跨流形干扰匹配产生概念；4) 该框架可生成可检验的预测，区分生物表征与大型语言模型的表征；5) 自然连接到强化学习作为统一计算原理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将神经流形、赫布细胞组装、全息记忆和干扰匹配四个平行发展的概念整合为一个统一的理论框架；2) 提出了先验几何流形结构与后天学习修正之间的关键区分；3) 重新定义了细胞组装为流形空间中的模糊吸引子；4) 阐明了知觉特征形成与概念形成的不同机制（域内vs跨域）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为理解生物神经表征与大型语言模型表征之间的差异提供了可检验的预测；2) 将概念学习与强化学习联系起来，为人工智能系统设计提供指导；3) 有助于解决绑定问题（binding problem），即不同感官信息如何整合为统一概念。

title: Machine-Centered Automation: A Function-First Design Framework for the Age of AI-Assisted Engineering

detail.title: Machine-Centered Automation: A Function-First Design Framework for the Age of AI-Assisted Engineering
detail.abstract: Industrial automation is most often specified by observing how a person performs a task and programming machines to reproduce that motion. This motion-replication default is intuitive but imposes a structural ceiling: the resulting system inherits constraints that exist only because the task was once designed around human dexterity and ergonomics. The framework addressed here is not a new optimization method but a decision discipline applied before automation architecture is specified. We argue that AI-assisted engineering makes this discipline urgent: human-data-trained AI, when prompted with task-level procedural descriptions, may privilege familiar human-action sequences and so risk industrializing motion-replication, whereas constraint-driven generative methods are biased toward functionfirst design. We contribute a function-first design philosophymachine-centered in process design, human-centered in governance and safety-together with a specification method of four machine-native levers, a replicate-versus-redesign gate with a safety veto, and a scored self-assessment diagnostic. We illustrate it with success and boundary cases and recast validation as four research questions.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了工业自动化中常见的"运动复制"范式，提出在自动化架构确定之前，应采用"功能优先"的设计哲学，并提供了具体的规范方法与诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在自动化架构设计阶段，避免AI辅助工程陷入"运动复制"的人类中心偏差，转向功能优先的机器原生设计？
AI.motivation: 传统的运动复制自动化方式会继承人类操作的约束，而AI辅助工程若基于人类数据训练，可能进一步固化这一偏差，亟需一种在设计前期进行决策约束的规范方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能优先设计哲学（过程设计以机器为中心，治理与安全以人为中心）；机器原生杠杆（four machine-native levers）；复制-重新设计门控机制（含安全否决权）
AI.method: 概念框架构建与规范方法提出，辅以成功案例与边界案例的说明，以及评分式自我评估诊断工具。
AI.findings: 提出了四种机器原生杠杆、一个复制vs重新设计的门控（含安全否决权）以及一个评分式自我评估诊断，并用案例说明了有效性及边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"功能优先"这一反直觉的自动化设计哲学，区分了AI辅助工程中人类数据训练与约束驱动生成两种路径的不同偏差倾向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业自动化从业者提供了可操作的设计决策框架（门控机制、诊断工具），帮助在AI辅助工程落地时避免无意识的运动复制陷阱。

title: When Research Ideas Are Cheap: Autonomous Discovery and Evaluation in Financial Regulation
affiliations: Oregon State University - College of Business and

detail.title: When Research Ideas Are Cheap: Autonomous Discovery and Evaluation in Financial Regulation
detail.abstract: When the marginal cost of a research idea approaches zero, the binding constraint on scientific production shifts from generation to evaluation. We study this shift by applying a frontier AI lab's science acceleration platform to 66 seed papers in financial regulation, yielding 52,800 research proposals and 855,246 pairwise tournament evaluations. Three findings emerge. First, the system maps 750 canonical natural experiments, of which 71.5% cite shocks absent from the associated downstream literature, but the expansion systematically favors library shocks (those identified through searchable and defined information sources with lower interpretive costs) over world shocks (those recognized through professional experience and higher interpretive costs). Second, AI-generated ideas are substantively grounded, citing verified events with accessible data sources; the ideas are compositionally novel, assembling known elements into new research designs. Third, the evaluation mechanism weights the five prompted criteria unevenly, prioritizing identification strength over other specified criteria. Identification strength is decomposed into five sub-dimensions capturing 41% of decisions, while falsification power, despite explicit prompting, is essentially absent; moreover, approximately 19% of evaluation language corresponds to unprompted criteria adjacent to the prompted criteria. We conclude agentic AI science acceleration platforms can expand the scope of a researcher's efforts, not merely scale their existing efforts, but the researcher should be cognizant of the importance of latent information structure, contextual enrichment based on domain knowledge, and the necessity of human-in-the-loop expertise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当研究创意的边际成本趋近于零时，科学生产从"创意生成"转向"创意评估"的范式转变。通过将前沿AI实验室的科学加速平台应用于66篇金融监管领域的种子论文，生成了52,800个研究提案和855,246次配对锦标赛评估。研究发现：AI系统覆盖了750个经典自然实验，但71.5%引用了下游文献未使用的冲击，且系统倾向于选择"图书馆冲击"而非"世界冲击"；AI生成的创意具有实质基础和组合新颖性；评估机制对各标准权重不均，识别强度占比41%，而证伪能力几乎缺失，约19%的评估语言涉及未提示的相邻标准。结论认为AI加速平台可以扩大研究者努力的范围，但研究者需意识到潜在信息结构、基于领域知识的上下文丰富化以及人类参与的必要性。
AI.research_question: 当研究创意的边际成本趋近于零时，科学生产的约束如何从创意生成转向创意评估？AI科学加速平台在这一转变中表现出怎样的特征与局限性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术使得研究创意的生成成本大幅降低，科学生产的瓶颈从"想出新想法"转变为"评估和筛选好想法"。然而，现有研究对这一转变的系统性理解不足，尤其是AI大规模生成的研究创意在实质性、新颖性和评估机制方面存在哪些特征和偏差，需要深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识生产理论、信息经济学、科学社会学（研究创意的生成与评估范式转变）
AI.method: 将前沿AI实验室的科学加速平台应用于66篇金融监管领域的种子论文，大规模生成52,800个研究提案，并通过855,246次配对锦标赛评估进行系统性分析。采用内容分析、分类编码和统计方法对创意的来源类型（图书馆冲击vs世界冲击）、实质基础、组合新颖性以及评估权重的分布进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 第一，AI系统覆盖了750个经典自然实验，71.5%引用了下游文献未使用的冲击，但系统偏好"图书馆冲击"（通过可搜索和可定义的信息源识别，解释成本低）而非"世界冲击"（通过专业经验识别，解释成本高）。第二，AI生成的创意具有实质基础（引用已验证事件和可访问数据源）和组合新颖性（将已知要素重新组合成新研究设计）。第三，评估机制权重不均，识别强度占决策的41%，而证伪能力尽管被明确提示却基本缺失；约19%的评估语言涉及未提示的相邻标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI时代科学生产从创意生成到创意评估的范式转变机制；提出了"图书馆冲击"与"世界冲击"的分类框架，阐明了AI在信息获取上的结构性偏差；系统量化了AI评估机制中的权重失衡问题，特别是证伪维度的缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI科学加速平台的使用者提供了重要警示：AI可以扩展而非仅仅规模化研究努力；研究者需重视潜在信息结构、基于领域知识的上下文丰富化以及人类在评估环节中不可替代的作用（human-in-the-loop）。为金融监管领域的研究设计提供了大规模的创意生成和评估方法论。

title: Collapsing the Depth-Breadth Tradeoff: AI-Driven Structured Interviewing for Enterprise Improvement Initiatives

detail.title: Collapsing the Depth-Breadth Tradeoff: AI-Driven Structured Interviewing for Enterprise Improvement Initiatives
detail.abstract: Enterprises improve through a continuous, human-driven loop: contributors generate ideas rooted in frontline observation and experience, those ideas are evaluated and tested, and the best are executed. This loop is intensely human-centered, and at scale it forces a tradeoff. Deep one-on-one elicitation-an expert interviewer who probes, challenges, and validates-produces high-quality, actionable ideas but does not scale, because expert interviewer attention is scarce. Broad participation through group workshops scales involvement but degrades elicitation: quieter contributors are crowded out, ideas are lost or duplicated, and the burden of organizing, structuring, de-duplicating, and synthesizing hundreds of ideas falls on a small team. We argue that AI-driven structured interviewing relaxes the interviewer-scarcity constraint and collapses this depth-breadth tradeoff, delivering expert-style elicitation to every contributor in parallel. We further reframe the unit of output from a raw idea to an initiative object: a standardized, benchmarked, de-duplicated, execution-ready record. We present the mechanism, a reference method, the initiative object, and an evaluation framework, and report directional results from a single-organization retrospective field study of more than one hundred improvement initiatives. The approach was evaluated in research-and-development process improvement and is argued to generalize to other discretionary improvement domains such as procurement and labor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI驱动的结构化访谈机制，通过并行化专家式深度访谈解决企业改进中"深度与广度不可兼得"的困境，并将输出单元从原始想法重构为标准化的"倡议对象"。
AI.research_question: 如何在不牺牲深度的情况下，大规模获取一线员工的高质量改进想法？
AI.motivation: 传统企业改进方法存在两难：一对一专家访谈效果好但难以规模化；小组工作坊覆盖广但质量下降、信息丢失。需要一种既能保持深度又能大规模并行的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机协作理论、结构化访谈理论、知识管理中的显性与隐性知识转化
AI.method: 提出AI驱动的结构化访谈机制，定义"倡议对象"作为标准化输出单元，通过单一组织回顾性实地研究（超过100个改进倡议）进行评估。
AI.findings: AI结构化访谈能够以并行方式为每位贡献者提供专家级的深度启发，显著压缩了深度与广度之间的权衡空间，在研发流程改进中取得了积极的方向性结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了AI打破"深度-广度权衡"的机制；2. 重构了改进输出的理论单元，从"原始想法"提升为结构化的"倡议对象"；3. 扩展了AI在人类密集型知识工作中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供可大规模部署的改进想法收集方法；2. 降低了专家访谈者的资源瓶颈；3. 可推广至采购、劳动力等其他自主改进领域；4. 为组织流程优化提供标准化评估框架。

title: The Normalisation of Debt-Financed Status Consumption: Social Media, Household Saving, and the Behaviour of Young Urban India
affiliations: Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Navi Mumbai, India

detail.title: The Normalisation of Debt-Financed Status Consumption: Social Media, Household Saving, and the Behaviour of Young Urban India
detail.abstract: This paper examines how social media has reshaped the consumption and saving behaviour of young urban India, arguing that it has normalised a pattern of aspirational consumption that exceeds current income and is financed by instalment debt under conditions where that debt consumes a disproportionate share of earnings, erodes precautionary buffers, and blurs the boundary between what a household can afford and what it cannot. The analysis distinguishes consumption utility from signalling utility and locates the cost in the latter. Drawing on Reserve Bank of India household-savings data, Securities and Exchange Board of India retail-derivatives loss studies, the live-events and buy-now-paylater markets, and the regulatory record on financial influencers, the paper documents the pattern across five domains. Consequences are assessed in two stages: near-term household and life-cycle effects, and long-term macroeconomic effects as the cohort enters its primary earning years while the national savings pool remains below its pre-pandemic trend and the population ages. Three counterarguments are addressed. The paper concludes that the normalisation of debt-financed status consumption, under the conditions identified, is costly to households and constitutes a structural macroeconomic vulnerability for India.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社交媒体如何改变印度年轻城市居民的消费与储蓄行为，发现其已将"超出当前收入、依赖分期债务融资、债务吞噬收入不成比例、侵蚀预防性缓冲"的炫耀性消费常态化，并对家庭和宏观经济构成结构性风险。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体如何重塑印度年轻城市居民的消费与储蓄行为？这种以债务融资的炫耀性消费常态化对家庭和宏观经济有何影响？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体时代年轻消费者普遍出现"入不敷出"的消费模式，但对其系统性影响缺乏全面分析，特别是从消费效用与信号效用区分、家庭层面与宏观层面联动的视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分消费效用（consumption utility）与信号效用（signalling utility），将成本定位于后者；结合生命周期理论、预防性储蓄理论及宏观经济脆弱性框架。
AI.method: 综合运用印度储备银行家庭储蓄数据、印度证券交易委员会零售衍生品亏损研究、现场活动与先买后付市场数据、金融影响者监管记录，对五个领域进行文献与数据交叉分析。
AI.findings: 社交媒体将债务融资的地位消费常态化，导致：1）近期内，家庭储蓄缓冲被侵蚀、生命周期福利受损；2）长期内，当该群体进入主要收入期时，印度国民储蓄池低于疫情前趋势且人口老龄化，构成结构性宏观经济脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号效用理论扩展到社交媒体时代的债务消费场景，构建了从微观炫耀性消费到宏观储蓄脆弱性的联动分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度（及类似新兴经济体）的金融监管、消费者保护政策、宏观审慎政策提供预警依据，提示需关注金融影响者监管和先买后付等信贷产品的风险。

reference: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 588; 42 Ga. St. U. L. Rev. 1119 (2026)
title: Regulating Psychological Wellness Grifters
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Regulating Psychological Wellness Grifters

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a legal policy paper, not a study with participants.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 588
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of social media has transformed the delivery of psychological wellness advice, shifting mental health guidance from licensed professionals to digital influencers operating outside of traditional regulatory frameworks. As the global wellness industry surpasses $2 trillion, millions of Americans—particularly adolescents and young adults—consume mental health content from uncredentialed creators who often monetize psychological distress without professional oversight. Documented harms include misinformation about psychiatric medications, improper management of suicidality, unqualified diagnostic claims, and the migration of disciplined clinicians into unregulated “life coaching” roles.

This Article argues that state professional licensing regimes—governing psychologists, clinical social workers, professional counselors, and marriage and family therapists—represent the most promising yet underutilized mechanism for addressing psychological wellness grifters. Current statutory definitions, exemptions, and complaint-driven enforcement models were designed for brick-and-mortar clinical practice and are ill-suited to broadcast-style digital content. The Article proposes modernizing licensing statutes to expressly encompass digital therapeutic communications, narrowing exemptions that enable regulatory arbitrage, strengthening interstate enforcement coordination, and imposing mandatory disclosure requirements.

Recognizing the structural limits of state-based oversight, the Article further proposes a complementary federal registration framework modeled on the Drug Enforcement Administration’s dual federal-state regulatory system for controlled substance prescribers. Such a framework would require registration and credential disclosure for compensated psychological wellness services delivered through interstate digital commerce while preserving state authority over professional standards. By combining state licensing reform with targeted federal registration authority, this dual-enforcement approach offers a constitutionally-grounded path to restoring accountability in the digital mental health marketplace.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了州级职业许可制度是应对社交媒体上“心理保健骗子”的最有前景手段，并提出结合州许可改革与联邦注册框架的双轨执法方案，以恢复数字心理健康市场的问责机制。
AI.research_question: 如何通过现有及改良的监管机制，有效遏制社交媒体上无资质人士提供的虚假心理保健建议及其造成的危害？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上心理健康建议传播迅速，但大量内容来自无资质创作者，导致药物误传、自杀管理不当、无资质诊断等危害；而现行州级许可制度是为线下临床实践设计的，无法适应数字广播式内容传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业许可监管理论、联邦-州双重监管架构（类比DEA管制药物制度）、监管套利与司法管辖权理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与制度比较研究：检视现行州级许可法规的法定定义、豁免条款及投诉驱动执法模式，并提出联邦注册框架的制度设计。
AI.findings: 1. 现行州许可法规不适用于数字广播式心理健康内容；2. 存在监管套利空间（如被处分的临床医生转行“人生教练”）；3. 州级执法在跨州数字商务中存在结构性局限；4. 类比DEA的双重监管模式可为联邦-州协同执法提供合宪路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证州职业许可制度在数字心理健康内容监管中的适用性与不足，并提出了一个具有宪法基础的联邦-州双重执法理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出现代化州许可法修订建议（明确数字治疗性沟通、收紧豁免、加强跨州执法协调、强制披露要求）；2. 提出联邦注册框架的具体制度设计，为政策制定者提供可操作的监管路径。

title: Home Economics: The Effect of a Foreign Buyer Tax on Marriages and Births
affiliations: , University of Mississippi - Department of Economics and University of Mississippi - Department of Economics

detail.title: Home Economics: The Effect of a Foreign Buyer Tax on Marriages and Births
detail.abstract: A growing literature argues that housing affordability is an important determinant of family formation, influencing both the timing and incidence of marriage and childbearing. We exploit the staggered introduction of British Columbia's foreign buyer tax (FBT), which imposed a 15-20% transfer tax on residential property purchases by foreign buyers beginning in 2016, to examine how a policy-induced decline in housing demand affected marriage and fertility. Using administrative data on marriages and births at the Local Health Area level from 2007-2021 and a staggered difference-indifferences design, we find that treated regions experienced approximately 1.6 additional births and 2.7 additional marriages per 1,000 women aged 20-44 each year following implementation. Log specifications imply increases of roughly 5 percent in births and 12 percent in marriages. These findings are robust across alternative estimators and a variety of robustness checks. We find little evidence that the results are driven primarily by migration or by declines in family formation in neighboring regions. Taken together, our results suggest that housing affordability is an important determinant of marriage and fertility decisions and that housing market policies can generate meaningful demographic spillovers.

AI.tldr: 利用加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省对外国买家征税（FBT）的政策冲击，研究发现该政策通过降低住房需求改善了住房可负担性，从而使受影响的地区每年每千名20-44岁女性增加约1.6例出生和2.7例婚姻，增幅分别约为5%和12%。
AI.research_question: 住房可负担性如何影响婚姻形成和生育决策？
AI.motivation: 已有文献认为住房可负担性是家庭形成的重要决定因素，但鲜有研究利用外生的政策冲击来识别因果关系。作者利用BC省外国买家税这一准自然实验，考察住房需求下降对婚姻和生育的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房可负担性影响家庭形成决策的理论，涉及住房成本对结婚时机、生育意愿的约束效应。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences），利用2007-2021年地方卫生区层面的行政数据，比较受FBT政策影响地区与未受影响地区的婚姻和生育变化。
AI.findings: 受政策影响的地区每年每千名20-44岁女性增加约1.6例出生和2.7例婚姻，对数规格下出生率增加约5%，结婚率增加约12%。结果对多种估计方法和稳健性检验均稳健，且非由移民迁移或邻近地区家庭形成下降驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为住房可负担性影响家庭形成决策提供了因果证据，拓展了住房市场与人口行为交叉领域的理论研究；揭示了住房市场政策具有显著的人口溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了住房政策影响人口结构（婚姻和生育率）的实证依据，表明住房调控政策不仅影响房地产市场本身，还会产生重要的人口结构溢出效应。

title: Tracking Inbound Portfolio Investments in Emerging Markets through the Global Financial Cycle, Sustainable Investing, and Disrupting Events
affiliations: Hitotsubashi University - Hitotsubashi University Business School

detail.title: Tracking Inbound Portfolio Investments in Emerging Markets through the Global Financial Cycle, Sustainable Investing, and Disrupting Events
detail.abstract: By investigating the determinants of inbound portfolio investments (PIs) to 15 emerging countries over the past decade, this study finds that the global financial cycle was an important determinant of PIs and shows the elusiveness of the dominance of global factors (GFs) over domestic factors (DFs) in the sense that VIX, the unique effective GF, was not strong enough to be more impactful than the effective DFs whilst having greater explanatory power than them.  This elusiveness can be said of each of four two-year subsample periods, although the pattern of relevance, the statistical significance, and the marginal impact of effective GFs on PIs were not stable across these periods.  The effectiveness of domestic short-term interest rates (DIR) as a DF challenges the view that domestic monetary policy has only feeble independence.  DFs related to three environmental (E) and social (S) issues – carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, human development, and worker protection – were associated with PIs as well.  The first two of these ES-related DFs were more impactful on PIs than VIX and DIR over the full sample period, and countries with higher management level of CO2 emissions and those with higher level of human development tended to receive more PIs.  By contrast, countries with stronger worker protections receive less PIs.  Worker protection is the only regressor that was effective in all three cases where not only PIs but also the two components (stocks and bonds) of PIs are analyzed.  The relevance and impact of ES-related DFs on PIs were mainly attributable to bond investments.

AI.tldr: 研究过去十年15个新兴国家的证券投资组合流入（PIs）发现：全球金融周期是重要决定因素，但全球因素（VIX）并不比国内因素更具主导性；国内短期利率、二氧化碳排放、人类发展水平、工人保护等环境与社会因素均显著影响PIs，且ES因素影响甚至超过VIX和利率。
AI.research_question: 新兴国家证券投资组合流入（PIs）的决定因素是什么？全球因素与国内因素何者更为主导？环境与社会（ES）因素是否影响PIs？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为全球因素主导资本流动、国内货币政策独立性有限，但作者质疑这一“全球因素主导论”，并通过引入ES因素拓展分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球金融周期理论、资本流动的推拉因素框架、ESG投资理论
AI.method: 基于15个新兴国家过去十年的面板数据，采用回归分析，分别考察全球因素（VIX）、国内因素（利率、ES因素）对PIs及其股票和债券成分的影响。
AI.findings: 1. VIX是有效的全球因素，但解释力不及有效的国内因素，不具绝对主导性；2. 国内短期利率有效，挑战货币政策独立性有限的观点；3. CO2排放管理好、人类发展水平高的国家吸引更多PIs；4. 工人保护强的国家反而吸引更少PIs；5. ES因素的影响主要体现在债券投资上；6. 工人保护是唯一对PIs、股票、债券均有效的因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了“全球因素绝对主导资本流动”的传统理论，揭示了全球与国内因素之间“难以捉摸”的复杂关系；拓展了ESG因素在国际资本流动研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示新兴国家：改善环境治理（如减排）和提升人类发展水平有助于吸引外资；但过度加强工人保护可能抑制资本流入；国内货币政策仍具一定独立性。

title: Behavioral Risk Profiling Across Five Countries: Loss Aversion, Risk Aversion, and the Reflection Effect
affiliations: University of Essex - Department of Economics and University of Antwerp

detail.title: Behavioral Risk Profiling Across Five Countries: Loss Aversion, Risk Aversion, and the Reflection Effect
detail.abstract: Risk profiling typically reduces investors' preferences to a single risk-return trade-off, despite extensive evidence that reference dependence plays a central role in decisions under risk and uncertainty. We show that three elicited indifference values are sufficient to jointly identify loss aversion and domain-specific risk attitudes over gains and losses, thereby measuring the reflection effect as a shift toward greater risk seeking in the loss domain, without imposing functional-form assumptions. Using data from over 25,000 respondents in five European countries, we find that loss aversion and the reflection effect differ markedly in prevalence: loss aversion is far from universal, with the median respondent loss neutral in three of the five countries, whereas the reflection effect is observed for the majority of respondents in every country. We further show that widely used survey-based risk questionnaires primarily capture gain-domain risk attitudes and provide little information about loss aversion or the reflection effect. These findings imply that substantially richer behavioral profiling is feasible without increasing survey complexity. The method provides a tractable tool for researchers interested in measuring these preferences at scale and has practical applications in personalized financial services, such as investor suitability assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅需三个启发式无差异值即可联合识别损失厌恶和跨领域风险态度，无需函数形式假设。基于五国2.5万受访者数据发现：损失厌恶并非普遍存在（中位数受访者在三国为损失中性），而反射效应在各国均占多数。传统风险问卷主要捕捉收益域风险态度，对损失厌恶和反射效应信息有限。
AI.research_question: 如何在不增加调查复杂度的前提下，通过简便方法同时识别投资者的损失厌恶和跨领域（收益域与损失域）风险态度，并测量反射效应？
AI.motivation: 传统风险画像将投资者偏好简化为单一风险-收益权衡，忽视了参照依赖在风险决策中的核心作用。现有方法难以大规模、低成本地测量损失厌恶和反射效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参照依赖理论（参考点依赖）、前景理论（损失厌恶、反射效应）、跨领域风险态度差异。
AI.method: 通过三个启发式无差异值（indifference values）联合估计损失厌恶和收益/损失域风险态度，不施加函数形式假设。使用来自五个欧洲国家超过25,000名受访者的数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (1) 损失厌恶远非普遍——五国中三国中位数受访者为损失中性；(2) 反射效应在各国多数受访者中均存在；(3) 传统调查式风险问卷主要捕获收益域风险态度，对损失厌恶和反射效应提供的信息有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出无需函数形式假设即可联合识别损失厌恶和反射效应的简约方法，揭示了损失厌恶的非普遍性以及反射效应的广泛存在，挑战了传统风险画像中将风险偏好视为单一维度的简化假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种易于大规模实施的投资者风险画像工具，适用于个性化金融服务（如投资者适格性评估），在不增加调查复杂度的前提下实现更丰富的行为画像。

title: The Promose if the EU's Draft Repurposing Programme
affiliations: King’s College London and University of Copenhagen - Centre for Advanced Studies in Bioscience Innovation Law (CeBIL)

detail.title: The Promose if the EU's Draft Repurposing Programme

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organisations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported, in part, by a Novo Nordisk Foundation International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme grant (Inter-CeBIL Programme, grant no. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: Government-led repurposing programmes are reshaping the division of labour in pharmaceutical innovation. A new EU Commission-drafted power would allow the European Medicines Agency (EMA) to add new therapeutic indications to marketed medicines without the marketing authorisation holder's consent. Companies oppose this power, but in weighing up enacting the power, society has a poor understanding of its potential to help patients. This study offers the first empirical assessment of the promise of the power. It analyses 198 medicines from 12 years, comparing EMA-authorised labels with US-authorised labels and a leading reference for off-label uses. Sixty-seven percent of the medicines have at least one additional use supported by clinical evidence, yielding a total of 320 potential new uses. Of these new uses, 39% are for new diseases and 61% for new patient cohorts, with a third of the cohorts for paediatric populations. Commentators generally omit discussing repurposing for new patient cohorts, even though it is a focus of the EU Commission. The study's results suggest that the power could be used to authorise a substantial number of evidence-based uses, especially those in the US, and find a new policy synergy for neglected populations.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次实证评估了欧盟委员会拟赋予EMA的强制适应症扩展权力。分析了12年间198种药物，发现67%的药物存在至少一种有临床证据支持的新用途（共320种），其中39%针对新疾病，61%针对新患者群体（含1/3儿童群体）。该权力有望大幅增加循证用药授权，尤其惠及被忽视人群。
AI.research_question: 欧盟拟赋予EMA不经上市许可持有人同意即可增加新治疗适应症的权力，其潜在的患者获益究竟有多大？
AI.motivation: 各方（药企反对、欧盟委员会推动）围绕这一权力争论激烈，但社会对其帮助患者的潜力缺乏实证理解。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 药物再利用（drug repurposing）与制药创新分工理论；监管权力配置的经济学分析。
AI.method: 对12年间（2007-2019）198种药物进行系统比较分析，对比EMA授权标签、美国FDA授权标签以及领先的标签外使用参考数据库，识别有临床证据支持的新适应症。
AI.findings: ①67%的药物至少有一个额外循证用途，共发现320个潜在新用途；②39%针对新疾病，61%针对新患者群，其中1/3为儿童群体；③许多新用途在美国已获批准；④评论者普遍忽略了对新患者群体的再利用讨论。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为强制适应症扩展权力的潜在影响提供系统实证证据，揭示了制药创新中公私权力划分的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定提供关键实证依据；发现美国已批准但欧洲未获批的适应症可作为优先授权对象；指出该权力可特别惠及儿科等被忽视人群，形成新的政策协同效应。

title: The Iso 17029 Accreditation Infrastructure Gap In European Sustainability Assurance

detail.title: The Iso 17029 Accreditation Infrastructure Gap In European Sustainability Assurance

declarations.ethicsApproval: The author, Souha BEL HAJ MESSAOUD, has no conflicts of interest to declare. Eco Fluent Solutions provides consulting services in the field of ISO management systems and VVB accreditation readiness, which is the subject matter of this paper.

detail.abstract:
The Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), as modified by Omnibus I (Directive EU 2026/470), establishes mandatory third-party assurance requirements for the sustainability statements of Europe's largest corporations. The reference standard for conducting this assurance ISSA 5000, published by the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB),  becomes effective for reporting periods beginning on or after 15 December 2026. The European Commission is required to adopt an EU-level limited assurance standard by 1 October 2026.

This paper argues that the supply-side infrastructure required to deliver accredited sustainability assurance at the scale the CSRD implies is structurally underdeveloped. While the CSRD creates two authorised assurance provider tracks ; statutory auditors and independent assurance service providers (IASPs), the second track, which includes Validation and Verification Bodies (VVBs) accredited under ISO/IEC 17029:2019 and ISO 14065:2020, represents a pool of organisations that is both limited in number and constrained in its capacity to expand rapidly. The accreditation process for a VVB operating under ISO 17029 requires a minimum of 9 to 18 months from a structured starting point, creating an institutional clock that is misaligned with the regulatory timeline. Drawing on the structural analogy of the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) Notified Body capacity crisis, where a similar mismatch between regulatory mandate and accredited body capacity produced documented bottlenecks, this paper identifies the key dimensions of the infrastructure gap and offers a framework for policy and market responses. The paper concludes that accelerating the development of the ISO 17029-accredited VVB ecosystem is not only a market opportunity but a prerequisite for the credibility of European sustainability assurance at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，尽管CSRD（经Omnibus I修订）要求欧洲大型企业强制进行可持续发展报告第三方鉴证，但供应侧基础设施严重不足。ISO 17029认证的验证与核查机构（VVB）数量有限且扩能缓慢（认证周期需9-18个月），与监管时间线错位。参照欧盟医疗器械法规（MDR）通知机构能力危机，本文识别了基础设施缺口的关键维度，并提出政策和市场应对框架，认为加速VVB生态系统发展是实现可信鉴证的前提。
AI.research_question: CSRD强制可持续发展报告鉴证要求下，供应侧基础设施（尤其是ISO 17029认证的VVB机构）是否具备足够容量来满足监管需求？能力缺口的关键维度是什么？如何借鉴MDR危机经验提出应对框架？
AI.motivation: CSRD对可持续发展报告提出了强制性的第三方鉴证要求，但供应侧（认证鉴证机构）的能力建设是否跟得上监管时间表，这一问题尚未得到充分关注。作者试图预警基础设施瓶颈，以避免重蹈MDR通知机构能力危机的覆辙。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性类比分析（Structural Analogy）：将CSRD的VVB能力瓶颈与欧盟MDR通知机构能力危机进行类比，以此为分析框架识别基础设施缺口的关键维度。
AI.method: 概念性分析与制度比较研究：基于监管时间线与认证机构建设周期的对比分析，结合对MDR危机案例的结构性类比，识别关键基础设施缺口维度，并提出框架性政策建议。
AI.findings: 1. CSRD下的VVB认证周期（9-18个月）与监管时间线严重错位。2. 授权鉴证机构的两条轨道中，IASP/VVB轨道供给能力极其有限且难以快速扩展。3. 与MDR通知机构危机的结构性相似性表明存在可预见的瓶颈风险。4. 加速VVB生态系统发展既是市场机会也是制度可信度的前提条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"制度能力与监管时间线错位"这一结构性分析框架引入可持续发展鉴证领域，通过MDR类比为理解新兴可持续鉴证市场的基础设施缺口提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了提前干预、加速VVB认证能力建设的具体政策建议框架。2. 为市场参与者（如潜在VVB机构、会计师事务所）指出了能力建设与市场进入的时间窗口和商业机会。3. 预警了CSRD实施可能面临的供应链瓶颈风险，有助于避免监管承诺与实际执行之间的可信度危机。

title: Same Bet, Different Markets: Cross-Market Pricing Anomalies and the Limits of Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Same Bet, Different Markets: Cross-Market Pricing Anomalies and the Limits of Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: This study examines the pricing relationship between two prediction markets trading on an identical binary event: the passage of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act by December 31, 2026. One market, Kalshi, operates as a Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)regulated exchange serving U.S. customers. The other, Polymarket, is an unregulated global platform settled in cryptocurrency. Despite trading on the same event with the same resolution criteria, the two markets exhibit a correlation of only 0.55 for probability levels and 0.22 for daily changes, with spreads reaching 26.1 percentage points. A mean-reversion trading strategy that enters when the spread exceeds 10 percentage points and exits at zero generates a 100% win rate across 9 trades between January and May 2026, with an average net return of 15.6% per trade and a mean holding period of 5.9 days. A secondary analysis tests whether these prediction market probabilities explain Bitcoin daily returns and finds no significant relationship for either market. The findings provide evidence that regulatory market segmentation creates persistent, tradable pricing anomalies in prediction markets, and that these anomalies are likely to diminish as Polymarket gains CFTC-licensed access to U.S. customers.

AI.tldr: 研究对比了Kalshi（受CFTC监管）和Polymarket（不受监管）两个预测市场对同一二元事件（数字资产市场清晰法案通过）的定价关系，发现两者相关性低、价差大，且基于均值回归的套利策略在9次交易中实现100%胜率和15.6%平均收益率。此外，预测市场概率无法解释比特币日收益率。
AI.research_question: 监管市场分割如何影响预测市场对同一二元事件的定价？两个市场的价格差异是否可交易？预测市场概率能否解释比特币收益率？
AI.motivation: 同一事件在两个结构不同的预测市场上存在显著定价差异，说明市场微观结构（尤其是监管状态）可能造成定价扭曲，而这种扭曲可能具有可套利性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、监管市场分割、预测市场有效性、均值回归套利
AI.method: 相关性分析、均值回归交易策略回测（价差>10%入场，0%退出）、比特币收益率线性回归
AI.findings: 1) 两个市场的概率相关系数仅0.55，日变化相关系数0.22，价差高达26.1个百分点；2) 均值回归策略在9次交易中胜率100%，平均净收益率15.6%，平均持有期5.9天；3) 两个市场的预测概率均不能显著解释比特币日收益率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管市场分割导致的预测市场定价异常，表明在有效市场假说框架下，监管壁垒可能成为市场效率的重要障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易者提供了可操作的套利策略（均值回归交易），并指出随着Polymarket获得CFTC许可，此类套利机会将减少，对政策制定者和市场参与者均有启示。

title: The Republic of Translational Medicine
affiliations: King’s College London, King's College London - The Dickson Poon School of Law and LML, University of Cambridge

detail.title: The Republic of Translational Medicine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No author has a personal or financial relationships with people or organisations that may or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported, in part, by a Novo Nordisk Foundation International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme grant (Inter-CeBIL Programme, grant no. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: Established pharmaceutical innovation theory holds that companies and patents are essential for developing new treatments. Yet, it does not adequately explain numerous clinical trials conducted by hospitals and universities. This paper introduces a new, complementary theory that describes a parallel system of innovation, focused on new uses of already authorised drugs, particularly once generics are available. These trials are driven by incentives previously associated with "open science" and "user innovation" rather than by patents and cost 90 per cent less than commercial equivalents. This "hidden" research system could regularly provide society with affordable treatments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与现有制药创新理论互补的"隐藏"研究体系理论，描述了医院和大学如何以远低于商业研发的成本，通过开放科学和用户创新的激励机制，探索已过专利期药物的新用途，从而为社会提供可负担的治疗方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么医院和大学开展的众多临床试验无法被传统的制药创新理论所解释？是否存在一套并行于专利驱动体系的、更高效的非商业创新机制？
AI.motivation: 现有制药创新理论强调公司和专利对开发新疗法至关重要，但无法充分解释医院和大学主导的大量临床试验，尤其是针对已上市（特别是已过专利期）药物新用途的研究。这一理论与现实之间的鸿沟驱动了本研究的开展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放科学（Open Science）理论；用户创新（User Innovation）理论；与传统基于专利和商业激励的创新理论形成互补。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念性论文（Conceptual Paper），基于对已有现象的整合分析提出新理论框架。
AI.findings: 存在一个"隐藏"的研究体系，由医院和大学主导，聚焦于已上市药物（尤其是仿制药）的新用途；该体系由开放科学和用户创新的激励机制驱动，而非专利保护；其试验成本比商业等效试验低90%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了与传统制药创新理论互补的"隐藏创新体系"理论，扩展了创新理论在制药领域的适用范围，将开放科学和用户创新引入药物研发分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了以极低成本为社会提供可负担治疗方案的可行路径，为医疗政策制定、药物再利用研究和公共卫生资源配置提供了新思路。

title: Minimum Wage in Brazil (1940-2026): Super-Exploitation, Socialization of Reproduction Costs, and Sanctioning Factors
affiliations: and Universidade Federal de Campina Grande

detail.title: Minimum Wage in Brazil (1940-2026): Super-Exploitation, Socialization of Reproduction Costs, and Sanctioning Factors
detail.abstract:
Aiming to understand the structural determinants of the purchasing power level of the minimum wage
in Brazil from a historical perspective, this study, through a literature and documentary review, using a
qualitative-quantitative analysis, interprets the historical determinants of the purchasing power of the
object in question from critical Latin American categories, specifically dependency theory and ECLAC
(Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean). Finally, it considers that the dissonance
between the variation in income per capita and the real minimum wage is characteristic of the super-
exploitation of labor in order to maintain the profit rate of underdeveloped capital, with social programs
simultaneously sanctioning this super-exploitation and socializing the costs of reproducing the
workforce.

AI.tldr: 本研究从历史视角出发，运用依赖理论和拉美经委会（ECLAC）的分析框架，探讨巴西最低工资购买力水平的结构性决定因素，认为人均收入与实际最低工资之间的不协调是劳动力超级剥削的体现，而社会项目则在合法化这种剥削的同时，将劳动力再生产成本社会化。
AI.research_question: 从历史视角看，巴西最低工资购买力水平的结构性决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解巴西最低工资购买力长期波动的结构性根源，尤其是其与经济发展水平之间的背离现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 依赖理论（Dependency Theory）与拉美经委会（ECLAC）结构主义发展理论。
AI.method: 文献与档案综述，结合定性与定量分析。
AI.findings: 巴西人均收入与实际最低工资之间的不协调（dissonance）是劳动力超级剥削（super-exploitation of labor）的特征，目的是维持不发达资本的利润率；社会项目在合法化这种超级剥削的同时，将劳动力再生产的成本社会化。
AI.theory_contributions: 运用依赖理论框架，将最低工资购买力问题纳入结构性不平等与外围资本主义的分析中，丰富了对拉美劳动力剥削机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示巴西社会政策（如社会项目）在劳动力市场中的双重作用——既缓解又合法化超级剥削，为政策制定者调整最低工资与社会政策提供批判性参考。

title: The Dismal Theorem in a General Equilibrium Climate-Economy Model
affiliations: Tilburg University - Department of Econometrics & Operations Research and University of Oxford

detail.title: The Dismal Theorem in a General Equilibrium Climate-Economy Model
detail.abstract: We show that Weitzman (2009)'s dismal theorem resurfaces naturally within a dynamic asset pricing framework with temperature-related disaster risk. If the climate disaster loss distribution is sufficiently fat-tailed, the risk-adjusted expected loss term diverges. Under unit elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS), this causes the social cost of carbon (SCC) to explode and the underlying optimization problem to have no finite solution so that the dynamic general equilibrium analogue of the dismal theorem applies. We suggest that, if the expected size of damages also increases with temperature, the fat tail becomes endogenous and the dismal result is more likely to be activated at higher temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，当气候灾难损失分布具有厚尾特征时，Weitzman（2009）的“ dismal theorem”（悲观定理）会在动态资产定价框架中自然重现，导致碳的社会成本（SCC）发散且优化问题无有限解。
AI.research_question: Weitzman（2009）的悲观定理是否以及在何种条件下会在动态一般均衡资产定价框架中重现？
AI.motivation: Weitzman的悲观定理指出，如果气候灾难损失存在厚尾不确定性，福利成本可能发散。但该定理在动态一般均衡框架下的适用性尚未被充分检验，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态资产定价框架（带温度相关灾难风险）、极值理论（厚尾分布）、跨期替代弹性（EIS）、理性预期一般均衡模型。
AI.method: 理论建模与解析推导。在包含温度相关灾难风险的动态资产定价模型中，分析损失分布厚尾程度对SCC和优化问题解的存在性的影响。
AI.findings: （1）当气候灾难损失分布具有足够厚尾时，风险调整后的预期损失项发散；（2）当EIS=1时，SCC发散且优化问题无有限解，即悲观定理的动态一般均衡版本成立；（3）若损失期望值随温度上升而增加，厚尾变为内生，且在更高温度下更易触发悲观结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Weitzman的悲观定理从静态福利分析扩展至动态一般均衡资产定价框架，并揭示了厚尾的内生性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定提供警示：如果对气候灾难损失分布的尾部风险认识不足，SCC评估可能出现发散性结果，从而影响减排政策的成本效益分析；同时提示政策应关注高温情境下厚尾风险的自增强效应。

title: Synthesis Report: Teacher Demographic Dividend Project (2022–2024) — Strengthening South Africa's Teacher Workforce
affiliations: Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch University - Department of Economics and University of the Witwatersrand

detail.title: Synthesis Report: Teacher Demographic Dividend Project (2022–2024) — Strengthening South Africa's Teacher Workforce

declarations.ethicsApproval: Permission for the overall research project and its various sub-streams was obtained from the Humanities Research Ethics Committee of Stellenbosch University. We also obtained approval from the DBE to conduct interviews with relevant officials and to access certain administrative datasets. Additionally, separate permission was also obtained from the DBE and all provincial education departments to distribute the survey to teachers.
declarations.funderStatement: This document was written as part of the Teacher Demographic Dividend project, which was supported by Allan & Gill Gray Philanthropies and the FEM Education Foundation.

detail.abstract:
The Teacher Demographic Dividend (TDD) research project (2022–2024) examined challenges and opportunities presented by South Africa's ageing teacher workforce. With nearly half of government-employed teachers aged 50 or older, the country faces an impending wave of retirements. Initially, researchers anticipated significant cost savings; however, the project revealed a more nuanced picture of teacher shortages, supply, and financing.

Key Findings

1. Teacher Shortages and Workforce Planning: Early projections warned of a critical shortfall by 2030, requiring universities to produce 50,000 graduates annually. Revised modelling suggests 33,000 new teachers per year will suffice. However, supply remains uneven, with an oversupply of secondary teachers and a shortage of primary educators, particularly in African languages and numeracy.

2. Class Sizes and Resource Constraints: Large class sizes persist, especially in underprivileged schools. National guidelines recommend a maximum of 35 learners per Grade 3 class; the 2017 average was 41, with nearly 70% of learners in overcrowded classrooms.

3. Recruitment and Retention: Fewer than half of surveyed teachers entered the profession as their first choice. Entry standards vary widely, contributing to under-preparedness among some graduates. Recruitment has drifted from policy guidelines, with appointments often made from priority lists. Approximately 50% of teachers indicated an intention to leave the profession within a decade.

4. Education Financing: Despite increases in per-learner expenditure until 2019/20, rising salaries and budget pressures have strained resources. Some provinces have cut teaching posts and reduced funding for early childhood education. Although South Africa outspends many peer nations on education, learner performance lags, pointing to inefficiencies in resource allocation.

5. Systemic Mismatches: Rural and no-fee schools struggle to attract qualified teachers, particularly in African languages and technical subjects. Women remain underrepresented in leadership roles, and no centralised database exists to match unemployed teachers to school-level needs.

Recommendations

Coordinate DHET, universities, and DBE to align graduate output with workforce needs; improve selection criteria and training curricula; reintroduce incentives for rural and hard-to-staff schools; reduce administrative burdens through teaching assistant programmes; provide mental health support for teachers and learners; improve data on teacher qualifications and subject specialisations; support female educators in accessing leadership roles; and return to policy-mandated recruitment processes.

Conclusion

Revised models indicate minimal financial savings from demographic shifts. The greater opportunity lies in improving workforce planning, recruitment, and educational outcomes. Integrating demographic forecasting into education planning and adopting data-driven policymaking can transform demographic challenges into opportunities for educational renewal.

AI.tldr: 南非教师人口红利（TDD）项目（2022-2024）发现，虽然教师队伍老龄化可能带来人口红利，但实际财务节省有限，更大的机遇在于改善劳动力规划、招聘和教育成果。研究揭示了教师短缺、资源错配和系统性不匹配等核心问题，并提出了多项政策建议。
AI.research_question: 南非老龄化教师队伍带来了哪些挑战与机遇？人口结构变化是否能为教育系统带来显著的财务节省和效益？
AI.motivation: 南非近半数政府雇佣教师年龄在50岁及以上，即将面临大规模退休潮。研究团队最初预期人口结构变化能带来显著成本节省，但需深入探究实际情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口红利理论、教育劳动力供需理论、教育财政效率理论、劳动力规划与匹配理论
AI.method: 研究项目（2022-2024）采用多种研究方法，包括：教师调查、劳动力供需建模与预测、教育财政数据分析、教师招聘与留任现状调研。
AI.findings: 1. 教师短缺模型被修正，年度需求从50,000人下调至33,000人，但存在结构性供需失衡（中学教师过剩、小学教师不足）；2. 班级规模普遍超标，约70%学习者处于拥挤教室；3. 仅不到半数教师将教育作为首选职业，约50%教师表示十年内可能离职；4. 教育支出增长但效率低，部分省份已削减教师岗位；5. 农村和免费学校难以吸引合格教师，女性领导力不足，缺乏中央化数据匹配系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了人口红利在教育领域的简单化预期，揭示了人口结构变化并不必然带来财务节省，更需关注劳动力规划与资源分配的效率问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了协调大学与政府部门、改善师资选拔与培训课程、重新引入农村学校激励措施、减少行政负担、提供心理健康支持、改善教师资格数据、支持女性教育领导力、回归政策规定的招聘流程等具体政策建议。

title: Dynamic Account Reference System: An Interactive Educational Tool for Introductory Financial Accounting
affiliations: Central Michigan University and Central Michigan University - College of Business Administration

detail.title: Dynamic Account Reference System: An Interactive Educational Tool for Introductory Financial Accounting

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted at Journal of Education for Business

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Dynamic Account Reference System (DARS), an interactive educational tool designed to enhance the learning experience for students in introductory financial accounting courses. 1 The tool provides an interactive platform where students can explore accounting accounts, understand their definitions, and view journal entry examples through a user-friendly interface. The tool features a comprehensive database of 30 common accounting accounts across all five major categories (Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Revenue, and Expenses), each with detailed definitions and transaction scenarios. The use of this tool can significantly improve student engagement and comprehension of foundational accounting concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为动态账户参考系统（DARS）的交互式教学工具，旨在帮助初级财务会计课程的学生通过用户友好的界面探索会计账户、理解定义并查看会计分录示例，该工具包含五大类别共30个常用会计账户的详细定义和交易场景，能显著提升学生的学习参与度和理解能力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过交互式教学工具提升初级财务会计学生的学习效果？
AI.motivation: 初级财务会计学生在学习会计账户和分录时常常感到困难，传统教学方法缺乏互动性，难以激发学生兴趣和理解深度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于建构主义学习理论和交互式学习设计原则，强调通过主动探索和即时反馈来促进知识内化。
AI.method: 开发了DARS交互式教学工具，包含30个常用会计账户的数据库，覆盖资产、负债、权益、收入和费用五大类别，提供账户定义、交易场景和分录示例。
AI.findings: DARS工具能够显著提升学生对基础会计概念的学习参与度和理解能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为会计教育领域的交互式学习工具设计提供了理论实践案例，验证了建构主义学习理论在会计教学中的应用效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财务会计教学提供了一种可直接使用的交互式辅助工具，帮助教师提高教学效果，帮助学生更直观地掌握会计账户和分录知识。

title: Technological Monopoly Rent: A Category for the Political Economy of the New Productive Forces

detail.title: Technological Monopoly Rent: A Category for the Political Economy of the New Productive Forces

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not report research involving human participants or patient data; no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding supported this research.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a category for the political economy of the artificial-intelligence era: Technological Monopoly Rent (TMR), defined as the value extracted from controlling access to productive capacities whose underlying outputs approach zero marginal cost. The central claim is that value in the era of the new productive forces is captured not principally as profit on living labor, nor as ordinary monopoly markup in a contestable market, but as rent on enclosed productive capacity. TMR is distinguished here from classical profit, from Marxian surplus value, and from standard monopoly rent along three structural axes. Its productive base is appropriated from a collective commons rather than purchased. It is extracted in exchange with no living labor in the production of each unit. And its non-rival, near-zero-marginal-cost structure makes the competitive equilibrium of standard theory unstable, so that concentration is the market's attractor rather than its pathology. The paper then offers the operative decomposition: technological monopoly rent resolves into a compute monopoly, a model monopoly, and a permission monopoly, corresponding respectively to control of the physical training substrate, control of the trained productive capacity built on appropriated knowledge, and control of metered access to a good whose marginal cost is effectively nil. The same enclosure structure recurs across six "productive-force ruptures" (AI, quantum computation, brain-computer interfaces, gene editing, robotics, and fusion) coupled into a single reinforcing system. A readable formal statement of the rent and of its cross-domain coupling is provided. The full treatment, with the complete empirical apparatus, appears in An Invitation After Abundance (Chen 2026, ISBN 979-8-9960105-0-9).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"技术垄断租金"（TMR）这一人工智能时代政治经济学的新范畴，指通过控制通往接近零边际成本产出的生产能力所提取的价值，并分解为计算垄断、模型垄断和许可垄断三种形式，横跨AI、量子计算、脑机接口等六大生产力断裂领域。
AI.research_question: 人工智能时代价值捕获的本质是什么？传统利润、马克思剩余价值和标准垄断租金能否解释新生产力的价值分配？
AI.motivation: 经典政治经济学范畴（利润、剩余价值、垄断租金）不足以解释AI等新生产力条件下价值捕获的结构性特征，需要提出新范畴来描述"零边际成本"与"集中化"并存的经济现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学；垄断租金理论；马克思剩余价值论；公共品与共有地理论；非竞争性商品经济学。
AI.method: 理论建构与范畴演绎，辅以跨领域案例比较（AI、量子计算、脑机接口、基因编辑、机器人、核聚变），提供可读的形式化模型。
AI.findings: TMR区别于经典利润、剩余价值和标准垄断租金的三条结构轴线：（1）生产基础来自对集体共有地的 appropriation 而非购买；（2）每单位产品的交换中不包含活劳动；（3）非竞争性、近零边际成本结构使竞争均衡不稳定，集中是市场吸引子而非病理。TMR可分解为计算垄断、模型垄断和许可垄断三种形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"技术垄断租金"这一新政治经济学范畴，系统区分了TMR与经典利润、马克思剩余价值和标准垄断租金的差异，揭示了零边际成本条件下市场集中化的内生机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI时代垄断的形成机制、价值分配不平等以及跨领域（六大生产力断裂）的资本积累逻辑提供了分析工具，对反垄断政策、技术治理和公共资源管理具有启示意义。

title: State-Level Utility Regulation in Nigeria: Establishing Feed-in Tariffs for Distributed Renewable Energy
affiliations: Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria, Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria and Covenant University

detail.title: State-Level Utility Regulation in Nigeria: Establishing Feed-in Tariffs for Distributed Renewable Energy
detail.abstract: Nigeria's recent decentralization of its electricity market under the Electricity Act 2023 empowers state governments to independently regulate distributed generation (DG). However, sub-national utility commissions currently lack the localized economic benchmarks necessary to design bankable Feed-in Tariffs (FiTs). Addressing this critical regulatory gap, this study evaluates the commercial viability of 20 MW standalone solar (PSS) and wind (WSS) systems, aligning with current regulatory capacity limits, across Nigeria's six geopolitical zones. Utilizing two decades (2003-2022) of ground-measured meteorological data from the Nigerian Meteorological Agency (NiMET), the methodology integrates a comprehensive loss-stack framework and varied debtequity structures to evaluate the Levelized Cost of Electricity (LCOE), Net Present Cost (NPC), and minimum FiT thresholds. These economic outputs are subsequently benchmarked against the prevailing cost-reflective Band-A tariff (₦134.08/kWh). The findings demonstrate that wind assets in high-resource corridors significantly outperform solar baselines; under a standard 50:50 debtto-equity structure, minimum FiTs for wind (WSS) range from a highly competitive $0.13/kWh in Jos to $0.35/kWh in Iseyin. Conversely, solar configurations (PSS) require higher FiTs ranging from $0.31/kWh in Maiduguri to $0.46/kWh in Port Harcourt, reflecting constrained capacity factors. These results highlight a substantial deficit between current centralized tariffs and actual private investor requirements. Ultimately, this research provides the essential, location-specific 2 pricing benchmarks needed by state regulators to de-risk decentralized renewable investments, thereby advancing Nigeria's Energy Transition Plan and SDG 7.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用尼日利亚20年地面气象数据，评估了20MW独立太阳能和风能系统在六个 geopolitical 区域的商业可行性，发现风能在高资源走廊的平准化电力成本（最低$0.13/kWh）显著优于太阳能（$0.31-$0.46/kWh），并为州级监管机构提供了制定上网电价的具体基准。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚2023年电力法下放分布式发电监管权限后，各州公用事业委员会缺乏本地化经济基准来设计可融资的上网电价，那么20MW独立太阳能和风能系统在尼日利亚六个 geopolitical 区域的最小上网电价阈值是多少？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚2023年电力法将电力市场监管权下放至州级政府，但各州缺乏本地化的经济基准来制定可吸引私人投资的太阳能和风能上网电价，这一监管空白亟需填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平准化电力成本（LCOE）、净现值成本（NPC）、综合损失框架、不同债务权益比结构。
AI.method: 利用尼日利亚气象局2003-2022年地面实测气象数据，运用综合损失框架和多种债务权益结构，计算LCOE、NPC和最小FiT阈值，并将其与现行成本反映型Band-A电价（₦134.08/kWh）进行对比基准测试。
AI.findings: 在50:50债务权益结构下，风电最小FiT范围为$0.13/kWh（Jos）至$0.35/kWh（Iseyin），太阳能PSS范围从$0.31/kWh（Maiduguri）到$0.46/kWh（Port Harcourt）。风能显著优于太阳能，且现行集中电价与私人投资者实际需求之间存在巨大缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 为尼日利亚分散化电力市场提供了首个基于20年地面实测数据、结合综合损失框架和多种融资结构的地区特异性FiT经济基准，填补了分布式可再生能源定价的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚各州监管机构提供了具体的地点和资源类型定价基准，帮助其设计可融资的上网电价以去风险化分布式可再生能源投资，推进尼日利亚能源转型计划和SDG 7目标。

title: Market Access Insight Series

detail.title: Market Access Insight Series
detail.abstract: Background: Precision medicine has transformed oncology drug development and health technology assessment (HTA). Biomarker-guided therapies generate large treatment effects, compelling biological rationale, and improved cost-effectiveness profiles, creating a widespread perception that molecular specificity reduces the evidentiary burden associated with NICE decision-making. Objective This paper challenges that perception. The central argument is that precision medicine does not eliminate uncertainty; it relocates uncertainty from population heterogeneity toward alternative domains including small-sample inference, biomarker validity, assay performance, basket trial methodology, external validity, treatment sequencing, and long-term outcome estimation. This argument is developed against an explicit comparator baseline: the uncertainty profile of conventional broad-population oncology trials evaluated by NICE. Methods A conceptual framework distinguishing five operationally defined uncertainty categories-clinical, statistical, structural, external validity, and decisionis developed, mapped against a conventional oncology baseline, and applied to three NICE technology appraisals: selpercatinib for RET fusion-positive NSCLC (TA756); larotrectinib for NTRK fusion-positive solid tumours; and sotorasib for KRAS G12Cmutated NSCLC (TA830). The framework is situated within the existing HTA uncertainty taxonomy literature. Results Across all three case studies, strong biological precision and compelling efficacy signals coexisted with substantial residual uncertainty in comparative effectiveness, long-term survival, treatment sequencing, and assay standardisationdomains in which conventional broad-population trials typically offer stronger evidence. NICE issued conditional positive recommendations via the Cancer Drugs Fund in each case. A structured cross-case comparison confirms that the relocation pattern is consistent across different molecular contexts and trial architectures. Discussion Biological plausibility strengthens prior confidence in observed effects but cannot substitute for empirical evidence on comparative effectiveness, durability, or real-world generalisability. Manufacturers must plan evidence generation programmes adequate to the distinctive uncertainty profile of biomarker-defined populations. Conclusion The analytical discipline applied to population-level oncology evidence must be applied with equal rigour to biomarker-defined evidence. Increasing biological specificity does not remove the need for structured uncertainty assessment. HTA methodological development must keep pace with the evolving precision oncology paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战"精准医疗降低证据负担"的普遍认知，论证精准医疗并未消除不确定性，而是将不确定性从人群异质性转移至小样本推断、生物标志物有效性、检测性能等替代领域。通过对selpercatinib、larotrectinib和sotorasib三项NICE技术评估的案例分析，发现强生物学精准性与显著的疗效信号与疗效比较、长期生存、治疗排序及检测标准化等领域的大量残余不确定性共存。NICE均通过癌症药物基金发布了有条件阳性推荐。
AI.research_question: 精准医疗是否消除了卫生技术评估中的不确定性？如果消除了，是如何消除的？如果未消除，不确定性发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 学界和实务界普遍认为分子特异性降低了NICE决策的证据负担，但这一认知可能误导证据生成计划和HTA方法发展。作者旨在纠正这一错误认知，揭示精准医疗下不确定性的真实结构变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出五类不确定性操作化分类框架：临床不确定性、统计不确定性、结构不确定性、外部效度不确定性和决策不确定性，并将其置于现有HTA不确定性分类文献中。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建与比较案例研究。以传统广谱肿瘤试验的不确定性剖面为显性比较基线，将五类不确定性框架应用于三项NICE技术评估案例进行系统跨案例分析。
AI.findings: (1)精准医疗未消除不确定性，而是将其重新定位到新的领域；(2)在三种不同的分子情境和试验架构中，不确定性迁移模式一致；(3)强生物学精准性与疗效比较、长期生存、治疗排序、检测标准化等领域的显著残余不确定性共存；(4)NICE均通过癌症药物基金发布有条件阳性推荐，表明决策者承认了这种不确定性结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地挑战了"精准医疗降低证据负担"的主流观点，提出了"不确定性迁移"（uncertainty relocation）的新概念，并构建了适用于精准肿瘤学情境的五类不确定性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)提示HTA机构需以同等严谨性对待生物标志物定义证据；(2)建议制造商根据生物标志物定义人群的独特不确定性剖面规划充分的证据生成计划；(3)呼吁HTA方法论发展跟上精准肿瘤学范式演变的速度。

title: What Drives Firms to Go Green? Cross-Country Evidence from Enterprise Surveys

detail.title: What Drives Firms to Go Green? Cross-Country Evidence from Enterprise Surveys
detail.abstract: This paper examines the determinants of firms' CO 2 monitoring and energy management adoption using the data from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys. Firm-level covariates, including size, sector, age and capabilities e.g. employee training, process innovation, R&D, foreign technology use, financial inclusion, and quality certification, are the strongest and most consistent predictors of environmental action. Experience with climate shocks and government procurement contracts also raises probability that firms engage in the adoption of environmentally responsible practices. At the country level, national environmental performance (EPI) increases the likelihood of green practices, while governance quality matters mainly for energy management. Newly constructed Business Ready Environmental Index does not explain much of crosscountry variation in CO 2 monitoring or energy management adoption. Overall, internal capabilities dominate in shaping firms' environmental behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文利用世界银行企业调查数据，发现企业内部能力（如规模、创新、培训等）是决定企业采用CO₂监测和能源管理的最强预测因素，而国家层面的环境政策和治理质量影响相对较弱。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素决定了企业采用CO₂监测和能源管理实践的决策？特别是企业层面特征与国家层面因素（如环境绩效、治理质量）的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 企业环境行为（如碳排放监测和能源管理）的驱动因素尚未被充分理解，尤其是企业内生能力与外部制度环境之间的相对作用需要厘清，以指导更有效的环境政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业环境行为决策理论；内部能力（资源基础观）与外部制度压力（制度理论）相结合的分析框架。
AI.method: 基于世界银行企业调查跨国数据，采用回归分析方法，考察企业层面变量（规模、行业、年龄、培训、研发、技术采用、财务包容性、质量认证等）和国家层面变量（环境绩效指数EPI、治理质量、商业就绪环境指数）对CO₂监测和能源管理采纳的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 企业层面特征（规模、行业、能力指标如培训、创新、R&D、技术引进、质量认证等）是最强且最一致的预测因素；2. 气候冲击经历和政府采购合同也提高企业采纳环保实践的概率；3. 国家环境绩效指数（EPI）正向影响绿色实践，治理质量主要影响能源管理；4. 商业就绪环境指数对跨国产出变异解释力有限；5. 企业内部能力主导其环境行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了企业内部能力相对于外部制度环境在环境行为决策中的主导作用，为资源基础观在企业环境管理领域的应用提供了实证支持，同时修正了制度理论中对外部压力过度依赖的倾向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：促进企业环境行为应更注重提升企业内部能力（如培训、创新支持、技术引进等），而非单纯依赖国家层面的环境法规或商业环境指数；政府可通过采购合同等手段激励企业环保行为。

title: Beyond Profit Maximization: Long-Run Bankruptcy Risk, Continuous Stress, and the True Cost of Debt-Financed Growth

detail.title: Beyond Profit Maximization: Long-Run Bankruptcy Risk, Continuous Stress, and the True Cost of Debt-Financed Growth
detail.abstract: Standard theory frames the borrowing decision as a comparison between the marginal return on borrowed capital and the rate of interest: a firm should borrow whenever an extra unit of debt raises current profit. This paper argues that the comparison is incomplete. Debt does not merely expand capital; it also raises the firm's long-run exposure to insolvency and imposes a continuous, non-pecuniary burden on the people attached to the firm-owners, managers, workers, families, suppliers, and communities. We embed these two "hidden" costs in an otherwise classical model. Bankruptcy is treated as a cumulative-hazard process, so that even a small annual probability of failure compounds into a large probability over a long horizon; stress is treated as a convex flow cost that accrues every period the debt is outstanding. The borrowing problem then becomes the maximization of long-run welfare rather than current profit. The central result is a modified optimality condition in which debt is worthwhile only while its marginal operating return exceeds the marginal expected bankruptcy loss plus the marginal stress cost. Because the classical rule omits both terms, privately "optimal" leverage is systematically excessive. A numerical illustration shows the gap can be large: in our calibration the profit-maximizing firm borrows more than three times the welfare-maximizing amount, and the additional borrowing turns positive welfare into a substantial loss well before any default actually occurs. The framework reinterprets the choice between aggressive leverage and slower, self-financed expansion as a choice between fast leveraged growth and resilient growth.

AI.tldr: 本文指出传统企业借贷决策理论忽略了债务的两项隐性成本——长期破产风险和持续非金钱压力负担，将经典利润最大化模型扩展为长期福利最大化模型，证明按经典规则借贷会导致杠杆率系统性过高，且数值模拟显示利润最大化企业借贷量是福利最优量的三倍以上。
AI.research_question: 企业在借贷决策时，除了考虑债务的边际收益与利率的比较外，还应考虑哪些被忽视的隐性成本？如何在理论上将这些成本纳入最优借贷条件的分析？
AI.motivation: 经典理论将借贷决策简化为边际资本回报与利率的比较，但现实中企业过度借贷导致的破产和利益相关者（所有者、管理者、工人、家庭、供应商、社区）承受的持续压力成本被忽视，导致私人最优杠杆率系统性偏高，需要更完整的理论框架加以修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 破产作为累积风险过程（cumulative-hazard process）建模——即使年破产概率很小，长期累积后也会变得很大；压力作为凸性流成本（convex flow cost）建模——每期债务存续期间都会产生非金钱负担。将借贷问题从当期利润最大化转向长期福利最大化。
AI.method: 理论建模：在经典模型中嵌入破产累积风险成本和压力流成本，推导修正的最优借贷条件。数值模拟：对修正模型进行校准，比较利润最大化与福利最大化下的最优杠杆率差异。
AI.findings: 最优借贷条件是债务的边际运营收益超过边际预期破产损失加边际压力成本时才有价值；经典规则忽略了这两项，导致私人最优杠杆率系统性过高；数值模拟显示利润最大化企业借贷量是福利最优量的三倍以上，额外借贷在违约发生前就已将正福利转化为实质性损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了经典的借贷决策最优条件，将破产风险和压力成本纳入理论框架；将"激进杠杆vs慢速自有资金扩张"重新概念化为"快速杠杆增长vs韧性增长"的选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供更全面的借贷决策框架，提示过度杠杆的隐性福利成本；为政策制定者和监管者提供理论依据，说明为什么私人最优杠杆率可能系统性偏离社会最优水平。

title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Bocconi University, Australian National University (ANU) and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
detail.abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing "nudges" and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but costeffectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较"助推"（nudge）与价格干预在五个市场（香烟、酒精、流感疫苗、电力、居民用水）中的效果，发现行为干预往往对应巨大的财政干预效果（如11%的电税或100%的疫苗补贴），且成本效益更高，但福利排序并非由成本效益决定。基于边际公共资金价值的扩展分析，助推在边际上具有高福利回报，而价格工具在规模化时能产生更大总剩余。
AI.research_question: 行为干预（助推）与传统价格干预相比，其经济意义和福利效果如何？
AI.motivation: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心，但其实证效果因估计的效应量往往较小而备受争议。作者认为，政策效果的经济意义应相对于替代政策的效果来衡量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际公共资金价值（Marginal Value of Public Funds）的行为扩展。
AI.method: 元分析：收集了来自600多项研究的1200多个估计值，比较五个市场中助推与价格干预的效果，并将助推效果转化为等效价格变化。
AI.findings: 1) 助推常对应巨大的财政干预（如11%的电税到100%的疫苗补贴）；2) 助推在所有市场中成本效益更高；3) 成本效益不能预测政策的福利排序；4) 助推在边际上有高福利回报，但价格工具在规模化时总剩余更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了比较行为干预与价格干预经济意义的方法论框架，并引入行为扩展的边际公共资金价值理论来评估福利效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在不同市场中比较助推与价格工具效果的方法，并揭示了成本效益与福利效果之间的非对应关系，有助于更科学地选择干预措施。

title: Binary climate data visuals amplify perceived impact of climate change
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Princeton University, Princeton University - Department of Computer Science and Princeton University

detail.title: Binary climate data visuals amplify perceived impact of climate change
detail.abstract: For much of the global population, climate change appears as a slow, gradual shift in daily weather. This leads many to perceive its impacts as minor and results in apathy (the "boiling frog" effect). How can we convey the urgency of the crisis when its impacts appear so subtle? Here, through a series of large-scale cognitive experiments (N=799), we find that presenting people with binary climate data (e.g., lake freeze history) significantly increases the perceived impact of climate change (Cohen's d = 0.40 [0.26, 0.54]) compared to continuous data (e.g., mean temperature). Computational modeling and follow-up experiments (N=398) suggest that binary data enhances perceived impact by creating an "illusion" of sudden shifts. Crucially, our approach does not involve selective data presentation but rather compares different datasets that reflect equivalent trends in climate change over time. These findings, robustly replicated across multiple experiments, provide a cognitive basis for the "boiling frog" effect and offer a psychologically grounded approach for policymakers and educators to improve climate change communication while maintaining scientific accuracy.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，与呈现连续气候数据（如平均温度）相比，呈现二元气候数据（如湖泊是否结冰）能显著增强人们对气候变化影响的感知，其机制是二元数据制造了一种"突然转变"的错觉，有助于克服"温水煮青蛙"效应。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数据呈现方式克服公众对气候变化影响的"温水煮青蛙"式麻木？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对许多人而言表现为缓慢渐变，导致感知影响微小、产生冷漠（"温水煮青蛙"效应），需要找到有效沟通方式来传达气候危机的紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: "温水煮青蛙"效应（缓慢渐变导致的感知钝化）；二元数据 vs. 连续数据的信息加工差异；认知错觉机制。
AI.method: 大规模认知实验（N=799）和后续复制实验（N=398），比较二元数据（如湖泊冻结历史）与连续数据（如平均温度）对感知影响的效果；计算建模分析认知机制。
AI.findings: 二元气候数据相比连续数据显著提升气候变化影响感知（Cohen's d=0.40）；二元数据通过制造"突然转变"的错觉发挥作用；该方法不涉及选择性呈现数据，而是对比反映相同趋势的不同数据集；结果在多项实验中稳健复制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"温水煮青蛙"效应提供了认知层面的解释机制；揭示了数据格式（二元vs连续）对风险感知的差异化影响；建立了认知错觉与气候沟通之间的理论连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育者提供了一种基于心理学的、不牺牲科学准确性的气候沟通策略——使用二元气候数据来传达气候变化影响的紧迫性。

title: Property Rights in Multi-centered Organ Exchange
affiliations: Ozyegin University

detail.title: Property Rights in Multi-centered Organ Exchange
detail.abstract: For patients with organ failure, receiving a deceased-donor transplant is often the only life-saving treatment. Cross-border exchange networks improve matching efficiency by integrating national organ centers, pooling their organ supplies and waiting lists. Because organ centers view their organ supplies as endowments, successful integration hinges on well-defined property rights. We propose three intuitive property-rights axioms and show that Top Trading Cycles is the most promising rule for successful integration, as it uniquely satisfies these axioms. The benchmark nointegration serial rule is inefficient, but we show that it also satisfies certain desirable properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了跨境器官交换网络整合中的产权分配问题，提出三条产权公理，证明Top Trading Cycles（TTC）机制是唯一满足这些公理的最优规则，而传统的无整合串行规则虽然具有某些合意性质，但效率低下。
AI.research_question: 在跨境器官交换网络整合中，如何设计一种满足产权公理的匹配规则以实现高效整合？
AI.motivation: 器官移植是器官衰竭患者的唯一救命手段，跨境交换网络通过整合各国家器官中心可提高匹配效率，但器官中心将其器官供应视为禀赋，因此成功的整合需要明确的产权界定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产权理论、公理设计方法、匹配市场设计理论（Top Trading Cycles机制、串行规则）
AI.method: 公理化分析：提出三条产权公理，通过理论证明比较TTC机制与无整合串行规则在不同公理下的满足情况。
AI.findings: TTC机制是唯一同时满足三条产权公理的规则，适用于跨境器官交换网络整合；而无整合的串行规则虽然满足某些合意性质，但效率较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将产权公理应用于跨境器官交换网络的设计，提出并验证了TTC机制在器官分配中的最优性，丰富了匹配市场设计与产权理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境器官交换网络的制度设计提供了理论依据，有助于各国器官中心在整合过程中建立公平高效的匹配规则，提升器官移植的可及性和生存率。

title: Making Equity Incentives Actionable: Internal Communication and Broad-Based Employee Ownership
affiliations: Harvard Business School, Harvard Business School and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Making Equity Incentives Actionable: Internal Communication and Broad-Based Employee Ownership
detail.abstract: Broad-based equity compensation gives rank-and-file employees a financial claim on firm value, but it does not clarify how employees should act on that claim. We ask whether communication around an equity plan can clarify these actions and motivate workers. In a field experiment at a building-materials supply company, locations were randomly assigned to receive shareholder letters framing stock appreciation rights around concrete behavioral norms or around abstract organizational values. Norms-based communication reduced turnover by 13.2 percentage points relative to values-based communication and increased employees' self-reported cultural identification. The retention advantage of norms-based communication was concentrated during a period of operational disruption, Hurricane Helene, when behavioral clarity was likely to be especially valuable. A pre-registered online study with construction-sector employees provides controlled evidence consistent with the field patterns, benchmarks norms and values communication against equity-only communication, and identifies message concreteness as the primary measured mechanism. These results suggest that internal communication is a complementary control mechanism that affects the implementation of broad-based equity incentives by clarifying the behaviors through which rank-and-file employees can act on ownership.

AI.tldr: 一项现场实验表明，在员工股权激励中，基于具体行为规范的沟通比基于抽象价值观的沟通更能降低员工离职率（降低13.2个百分点），尤其是在运营混乱（飓风海伦妮）时期效果更为显著。在线实验验证了这一发现，并指出信息具体性是主要机制。
AI.research_question: 在广泛基础的员工股权激励中，围绕股权计划的沟通方式（基于具体行为规范 vs. 基于抽象价值观）如何影响员工的行为（如离职率和文化认同）？
AI.motivation: 广泛基础的股权激励赋予员工对公司价值的财务索取权，但并未阐明员工应如何行动来行使这一权利。作者希望探索沟通是否可以作为补充性的控制机制，帮助员工明确行为方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制机制理论、股权激励的沟通效果、行为规范与价值观框架、信息具体性理论。
AI.method: 现场实验（建筑材料供应公司，随机分配规范性沟通/价值观沟通）加预先注册的在线实验（建筑行业员工），测量离职率、文化认同、机制检验。
AI.findings: 1. 规范沟通比价值观沟通降低离职率13.2个百分点。2. 规范沟通提高员工文化认同。3. 效果在运营混乱期（飓风海伦妮）更显著。4. 信息具体性是主要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了内部沟通作为股权激励的互补控制机制，阐明了行为规范沟通如何帮助员工理解其在股权计划中的"所有者"角色，扩展了对广泛股权激励实施效果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计股权激励沟通方案提供实证依据：强调使用具体行为规范而非抽象价值观来沟通股权计划，可有效降低离职率并增强员工文化认同，尤其在危机时期更有效。

title: The Cascade of Inattention: Observability and Responsibility in Vertical Hierarchies

detail.title: The Cascade of Inattention: Observability and Responsibility in Vertical Hierarchies
detail.abstract: A companion working paper-the Equilibrium Without Collusion model (hereafter ewc; SSRN working paper, 2026)-showed that recurring control deficiencies can be an equilibrium without collusion: when a core auditor's observability of a specialist's work is low, declining to understand that work is individually rational, and the deficiency persists with no party deviating and no side payment changing hands. That mechanism turned on a single primitive-accountability is allocated in proportion to what one is seen to be able to observe. This paper nests that primitive vertically and shows that the nesting generates two results the single dyad cannot. In a three-tier hierarchy-executive, manager, employee-each monitoring relationship is an instance of the companion paper's dyad, and the middle player is Janus-faced: observed from above, observer from below. The first result is a cascade of inattention: because the manager's incentive to watch the employee is gated by the executive's watching of the manager, a withdrawal of attention at the top propagates downward-if the executive does not watch the manager, the manager does not watch the employee, and the employee does not work. The executive's watching is precisely what rescues the manager from his own strategic inattention. The second is a two-faced penalty: a heavier penalty on the manager sharpens his discipline of the employee (a structural consequence of the companion paper's attribution premise) while making him less visible to the executive (the companion paper's penalty paradox)-the same comparative static pointing in opposite directions at the two tiers, the net effect set by how much the upward paradox is transmitted back down through the cascade. Both results are established as monotone directions on a code-faithful three-tier model and verified across a grid of detection-curvature and diffuse-penalty values; discontinuities, thresholds, and magnitudes are flagged as functionalform-dependent throughout. A closing section generalizes the frame from a single line to a branching hierarchy, where the same mechanism produces two effects a line cannot: under a binding apex attention budget, disciplined and collapsed divisions coexist within one firmthe firm breaking symmetry even between identical branches-while relative cross-branch evaluation attenuates the coexistence. The audit dyad of the companion paper emerges as the special corner of a general frame in which a monitor has neither credit for nor production stake in the work below-which is why it is the configuration most exposed to the pathology.

AI.tldr: 本文在“无合谋均衡”模型基础上，将二元审计关系嵌套进三层垂直层级（高管—经理—员工），发现两个新结果：注意力逐级向下级联，以及经理面临“双重惩罚”效应——加重对经理的惩罚既能强化其对下属的约束，又因惩罚悖论降低自身被上级观察的可见性，净效果取决于向上悖论通过层级级联回传的程度。本文还将框架推广到分支层级结构，揭示了对称分支间的不对称分化现象。
AI.research_question: 当核心审计师对专家工作的可观察性较低时，拒绝理解该工作是个人理性的，且缺陷持续存在、无人偏离、无任何私下支付发生。该机制依赖于一个原始前提——问责制按一个人被观察到能够观察到的东西来分配。本文将这一前提嵌套进垂直层级中，探究这种嵌套产生了哪些单一二元关系无法产生的现象。
AI.motivation: 已有工作论文（无合谋均衡模型，SSRN 2026）揭示了二元审计关系中控制缺陷的均衡存在性，但其机制仅限于单一审计师-专家二元关系。现实审计场景往往涉及多层监督层级（如高管-经理-员工），需要理解这种层级结构如何影响控制缺陷的传播与治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于“无合谋均衡”模型的核心前提——问责制按观察可见性分配。将三层垂直层级（高管-经理-员工）中的每一层监督关系视为二元模型的实例，中层参与者（经理）具有两面性：从上往下看被观察，从下往上看是观察者。
AI.method: 建立忠实于代码的三层模型，通过单调方向分析建立两个核心结果，并在检测曲率和扩散惩罚值的网格上进行数值验证。此外，将框架从单线层级推广至分支层级结构。
AI.findings: 1. 注意力级联效应：因经理监督员工的激励受限于高管监督经理，高层注意力的撤回会向下传播——若高管不监督经理，经理便不监督员工，员工便不工作。高管的监督恰恰是将经理从自身策略性疏忽中解救出来的关键。2. 双重惩罚效应：加重对经理的惩罚，一方面强化其约束员工的能力（结构性后果），另一方面降低其向上被观察的可见性（惩罚悖论），同一比较静态在两个层级方向相反，净效果取决于向上悖论通过级联回传的程度。3. 推广到分支层级时，在有限的顶端注意力预算下，纪律严明的分支与崩溃的分支可在同一公司内共存，打破对称分支间的对称性，而跨分支的相对评估会削弱这种共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 将二元审计关系模型拓展至垂直层级和分支层级结构，揭示了层级嵌套产生的注意力级联和双重惩罚效应，为理解多层审计监督中的控制缺陷传播提供了理论框架。发现“无合谋均衡”的二元关系是通用框架中监督者既无下层工作功劳也无生产利益的特殊情形，因此是最易暴露于病理状态的配置。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计实务中多层监督结构的设计提供指导：高管需保持对中层管理者的监督以激活整个监督链条；加重对中层惩罚的效果具有双重性，需权衡其对下层约束的强化与对上可见性减弱的净效应；有限注意力预算下，组织内不同分支可能出现不对称分化，跨分支评估可作为缓解策略。

title:
Proof-of-Conviction:
A Cryptoeconomic Framework for Type-sorting Token Distribution through Enforced Illiquidity and Continuous-time Screening

detail.title:
Proof-of-Conviction:
A Cryptoeconomic Framework for Type-sorting Token Distribution through Enforced Illiquidity and Continuous-time Screening

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and sole developer of Streamlock, the protocol whose mechanism is formalized in this paper. The paper describes and analyzes a mechanism designed and implemented by the author.

detail.abstract: Token distribution mechanisms in cryptocurrency markets overwhelmingly rely on immediate resale liquidity (λ = 1), creating an adverse selection environment in which no observable behavior distinguishes high-conviction participants from shorthorizon extractors. This paper introduces a novel primitive: exit timing as a priced signal of conviction. By formalizing the liquidity spectrum λthe fraction of purchased tokens on which the protocol imposes a binding resale restriction at the point of purchasewe show that at λ = 1, token markets exhibit coordination failures consistent with the noise-trader model [De Long et al., 1990] and adverse selection dynamics [Akerlof, 1970], producing a race-to-liquidity in which early exit is individually rational regardless of conviction. Empirical evidence supports these predictions: fewer than 1.4% of tokens on pump.fun graduate to sustained trading, 84.7% of major 2025 token launches trade below their oering price, and buyback programs totaling over $70 million have failed to durably support prices at revenue-generating protocols. We formalize Proof-of-Conviction, a mechanism in which λ = 0 at purchase for all participants and exit is gated by a milestone-dependent state machine (GRIND → FREEZE → UNLOCK) with a linear fee decay from 50% to 1% during unlock windows. The fee schedule transforms exit timing into a priced signal: when a holder exits and how much they pay reveals information about their private valuation. We prove two results that formalize this: non-exiters reveal a lower bound on their reservation value (Theorem 4.1), and exiters reveal a bracketed type interval through their choice of exit time (Corollary 4.2). Together, these results constitute a screening mechanism in the Rothschild & Stiglitz [1976] tradition that produces monotone sorting of holder types through observable behavior. Proof-of-Conviction is presented as a conviction-revealing primitive that any mechanism designer can adopt, not as a complete token distribution system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“退出时机”作为信念（conviction）的定价信号，并设计了Proof-of-Conviction机制，通过线性费用衰减和里程碑式状态机，解决代币市场中因即时流动性（λ=1）导致的逆向选择和协调失灵问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在代币分配机制中通过可观察行为区分高信念参与者与短期提取者，从而缓解逆向选择和协调失灵？
AI.motivation: 现有代币市场依赖即时转售流动性（λ=1），导致无论信念高低，早期退出都是个体理性选择，形成“流动性竞赛”和逆向选择，大量代币项目失败（如pump.fun仅1.4%代币存活、84.7%的代币低于发行价、买回计划失效）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 噪声交易者模型（De Long et al., 1990）、逆向选择理论（Akerlof, 1970）、Rothschild & Stiglitz（1976）筛选机制、信号传递理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与形式化证明：定义流动性频谱λ，设计Proof-of-Conviction机制（GRIND→FREEZE→UNLOCK三阶段状态机、线性费用衰减50%→1%），并证明定理4.1（非退出者揭示保留价值下界）和推论4.2（退出者通过退出时间揭示类型区间）。
AI.findings: （1）λ=1时，代币市场出现协调失灵和逆向选择；（2）Proof-of-Conviction机制可将退出时间转化为信念的定价信号，实现持有者类型的单调排序（monotone sorting）；（3）机制贡献：不依赖外部声誉或质押，仅通过可观察的退出行为实现筛选。
AI.theory_contributions: 将退出时间重新定义为信念的信号，拓展了信号传递理论在代币设计中的应用；将Rothschild & Stiglitz筛选机制引入加密资产领域，形式化证明了对持有者类型的单调排序。
